notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) worked cleanly (HTTP 200) on freedomtree.in this session -- no Cloudflare challenge encountered this time (prior Home-Decor pass had hit 429s and used translate.goog, which is now banned; not needed here). Site is Shopify. Checked: full main-nav collection list scraped from homepage HTML (all /collections/* links, ~140 collections spanning Furniture, Dining & Entertaining, Home Textiles, Clothing, Lighting, Decor, Gifting -- no 'Pets'/'Pet Care' nav entry). Found one pet-relevant collection not in the main mega-menu: /collections/toys-for-kids-and-pets (mixed collection: 8 DOLLS product_type + 13 DOG TOYS product_type). Confirmed a dedicated, correctly-titled collection exists at /collections/dog-toys ('Best Dog Toys - Soft Toys for Dogs Online by Freedom Tree') containing exactly the same 13 DOG TOYS products (verified via /collections/dog-toys/products.json limit=250 AND by counting unique product hrefs in the rendered collection-grid HTML of that page -- 13 unique product slugs, one duplicate render of a sold-out item). Used /collections/dog-toys as the canonical link since it is pet-exclusive (the kids-and-pets collection mixes in DOLLS, which are excluded/out of scope). Tried /collections/pet-toys, /collections/pets, /collections/pet-care, /collections/pet-accessories, /collections/dog-toy as possible dedicated URLs -- only pet-toys returned 200 but with 0 products (empty/orphan collection, not used). Absence proof for all other Pet Care sub-categories (beds, bowls/feeders, grooming, leashes/collars, carriers, crates, litter, clothing, training): (1) paginated /collections/all/products.json across the full catalog (1933 products, 8 pages of 250, page 9 empty = confirmed end) and collected all 116 distinct product_type values -- only 'DOG TOYS' matched any pet keyword (PET/DOG/CAT); (2) cross-checked with /search/suggest.json for 'pet', 'dog', 'cat bed', 'pet bed', 'pet bowl', 'leash' -- search is non-discriminating/fuzzy (e.g. 'pet bed' surfaced generic wood BEDS and DOG TOYS, 'leash' returned 0), consistent with no other pet inventory rather than a search-tool false negative, since the product_type census independently confirms it. Freedom Tree is primarily a printed-textile/furniture/tableware home decor brand (matches prior Home-Decor pass characterization); its only genuine Pet Care line is a small dog-toy range.
